items.question: Do I need a new website to use Agentic Chat?
items.answer: No. Add the chat widget to the site you already have. It works on any website where you can paste a snippet.

items.question: Is this only for support chat?
items.answer: No. The same agent handles sales and support: answering questions, capturing leads, looking up records and handing off to your team.

items.question: Can the agent use our own data?
items.answer: Yes. Workflows can identify the visitor and look them up in your own system before the agent replies, so answers use real context.

items.question: Can we keep a human in the loop?
items.answer: Yes. Hand conversations to people through support queues and live chat, with the full history attached.

items.question: Which channels are supported?
items.answer: Your website chat widget, plus WhatsApp, Messenger and Telegram for the same agent.

items.question: Where do registration and login happen?
items.answer: All account actions happen in app.divvylore.com.

items.question: Need a website that ranks?
items.answer: Our sister product builds fast, SEO-ready websites and grows them with content. Agentic Chat plugs into it when you have both.
